message_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-a74a2b29-cc53-462c-8521-a76f6eacd7aa-1","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"location_action","severity":"high","explanation":"同一时刻（18点）Vela 的位置与已确立事实冲突：证据表明她在西码头的 Observatory Gate Four，而非东码头。","reasoning":"当前草稿断言 18点 Vela 站在东码头。证据 span fixture-span-basalt_observatory-5 在同一时间锚点“At 18点 on the same day”下明确记载 Vela 站在西码头的 Observatory Gate Four，并直接否定东码头（“not the east pier”）。静态设定 fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-4 进一步确立 Observatory Gate Four 位于西码头而非东码头，排除了同一地点被误称的可能。两者共享同一主体（Vela）、同一时间（18点）与同一范围（位置），因此无法共存。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"At 18点 on the same day","evidence_anchor":"At 18点 on the same day","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-5","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-5","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-5"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-4","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-4","relation":"context","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-4"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-5","role":"current_context"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-4","role":"prior_state"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"At 18点 on the same day, Vela stood on the east pier.","after":"At 18点 on the same day, Vela stood at Observatory Gate Four on the west pier."},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-a74a2b29-cc53-462c-8521-a76f6eacd7aa-1","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"同一时间锚点下，证据明确记载 Vela 位于西码头的 Observatory Gate Four 并否定东码头，与草稿断言直接冲突。"}]}
